## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The setter’s key handling should be fixed because mixed-case writes cannot be retrieved through the case-insensitive getter.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cache.py:27 — correctness — Calling `set("Alpha", 1)` followed by `get("Alpha")` returns `None` instead of `1`. The setter stores the original key, while `get()` lowercases every lookup; the existing round-trip test only writes a lowercase key. Store under `key.lower()` and add a mixed-case write test covering retrieval and replacement through different casings. — Callers using uppercase or mixed-case keys lose access to cached values, and writes using different casings fail to replace the same logical entry.
